title: Regrets, Reproaches & Near Misses
goal: Express past regrets, reproaches and counterfactual near misses and read a deadline story
grammar: regrets-reproaches & pluscuamperfecto-subjuntivo-si: debería haber, arrepentirse de haber, si + pluperfect subjunctive

items: I can express past regrets and reproaches with *debería haber*, *tendría que haber* and *me arrepiento de haber*.
I can describe counterfactual past outcomes and near misses with *si* + pluperfect subjunctive + conditional perfect.
I can read a workplace deadline story integrating warnings, conditions, backups and relief.
